// PROBE — must turn tests/unit/dynamic-page-params-awaited.test.ts RED.
// A server page reading the Next 16 params Promise as if it were an object:
// `params.id` is undefined at runtime and the lookup below matches anything.
import { getCustomerProfile } from "../../agent/actions"

interface Props {
    params: { id: string }
}

export default async function ProbePage({ params }: Props) {
    const customer = await getCustomerProfile(params.id)
    return <div>{customer?.name}</div>
}
